title: A Parcel Is a Chain of Decisions
audience: Curious general viewers who enjoy clear visual explanations
thesis: A delivery is not one continuous trip; it is a sequence of handoffs, records, and decisions.
payoff: The parcel reaches its destination because separate steps reconnect into one traceable journey.

visual_system.name: Paper Signal
visual_system.signature_motif: One acid-lime envelope leaves a printed route fragment at each handoff; the fragments join only at the end.
visual_system.palette_logic: Warm off-white is the physical world, charcoal marks uncertainty, and acid lime is reserved for the parcel's next step.
visual_system.typography: Use a compact grotesk for labels and a large condensed face for chapter statements; keep essential data off textured paper.
visual_system.composition_grammar: Begin with one isolated object, widen to reveal the system, use aligned station cards for comparisons, and return to the envelope.
visual_system.motion_grammar: Every slide represents a handoff, every stamp records a state change, and only the final movement connects the route.
avoid: No fake three-dimensional bevels or plastic materials.
No decorative icons that do not represent a real step.
No repeated centered title card for every chapter.
No invented performance statistics presented as facts.

chapters.purpose: Establish the simple promise of delivery and create a question about what it requires.
Show that delivery depends on distinct handoffs and their records.
Reconnect the separate steps and deliver the opening payoff.

claims.text: A delivery can be explained as a series of connected handoffs.
Printed route fragments are a visual metaphor for a record accumulating across steps.
The joined route is a designed explanation, not operational tracking data.

scenes.viewer_question: How does one small parcel cross a much larger system?
scenes.visual_argument: An isolated envelope appears too small to explain the journey implied by its destination label.
scenes.visible_action: A single lime envelope slides into an empty paper field; a route label is visible but its path is absent.
scenes.topic_specificity: The destination label creates the parcel-delivery promise while the missing route makes the hidden system the subject.
scenes.composition: Keep the envelope low and right of center; leave a large unmarked route-shaped gap above it.
scenes.change_from_previous: This is the establishing image; later scenes add context rather than repeat a title layout.
scenes.motion_purpose: The single slide establishes the object and gives the viewer one focal point.
scenes.hold_reason: Hold the destination label long enough to read before revealing how much the simple promise hides.

scenes.viewer_question: What sits between the sender and the recipient?
scenes.visual_argument: The route becomes a set of separate stations rather than one uninterrupted line.
scenes.visible_action: Three paper stations unfold left to right; the envelope moves only when one station hands it to the next.
scenes.topic_specificity: The repeated handoff is the core mechanic, so motion is attached to station-to-station transfer.
scenes.composition: Use a wide horizontal route with the envelope in motion and each station in a separate third of the frame.
scenes.change_from_previous: Move from one isolated object to a wide process map with multiple points of attention.
scenes.motion_purpose: Each transfer creates a new state, making the process legible instead of adding decorative movement.
scenes.hold_reason: Pause after the third station appears so viewers can trace the route from origin to destination.

scenes.viewer_question: What changes when the parcel changes hands?
scenes.visual_argument: A handoff becomes visible as a state change recorded on the parcel's route strip.
scenes.visible_action: A square paper stamp lands beside the envelope; its route fragment prints into the strip and remains after the envelope moves on.
scenes.topic_specificity: A stamped fragment is a physical metaphor for information a process must carry between separate steps.
scenes.composition: Use a close crop with the envelope at lower left and the emerging record strip running diagonally toward upper right.
scenes.change_from_previous: Replace the full route view with a tactile close-up to explain one handoff in detail.
scenes.motion_purpose: The stamp impact marks the exact point where the parcel's state changes.
scenes.hold_reason: Hold the new mark after impact so viewers can compare the before and after states.

scenes.viewer_question: Why are the handoffs separate instead of one long move?
scenes.visual_argument: Side-by-side station cards expose the information that has to survive each transfer.
scenes.visible_action: Two paper panels compare a parcel leaving one station with the same parcel arriving at the next; one strip bridges both panels.
scenes.topic_specificity: The matched parcel and bridging strip make continuity across a handoff the comparison, not a generic arrow.
scenes.composition: Split the canvas into sender and receiver panels with a continuous route strip through the center.
scenes.change_from_previous: Shift from close-up detail to a paired comparison that shows two states at once.
scenes.motion_purpose: Movement across the center strip lets viewers inspect what is preserved between states.
scenes.hold_reason: Keep both states visible long enough to compare their labels and connecting strip.

scenes.viewer_question: How do separate records become one understandable journey?
scenes.visual_argument: Fragments from earlier scenes form a continuous route only when the handoffs are considered together.
scenes.visible_action: Earlier stamped fragments slide into alignment around the envelope; the route becomes continuous while station cards recede.
scenes.topic_specificity: The resolution pays off the repeated fragment motif and makes the chain—not a single movement—the point.
scenes.composition: Arrange fragments along a rising diagonal that ends at the envelope; reused shapes return in new relationships.
scenes.change_from_previous: Move from side-by-side states to an integrated whole; the pieces return with an altered meaning.
scenes.motion_purpose: Alignment is the argument: separate pieces become a legible system when connected.
scenes.hold_reason: Hold the joined route so viewers can inspect how the separate marks connect.

scenes.viewer_question: What did the route reveal that the opening image hid?
scenes.visual_argument: The same envelope now sits inside a complete route, making invisible work around a simple promise visible.
scenes.visible_action: The envelope reaches the destination card; the completed route remains and the opening label returns in a smaller contextualized form.
scenes.topic_specificity: Returning the opening object and label creates a payoff from the route system built across the film.
scenes.composition: Center the envelope at the route end and place the opening promise above it with negative space around the takeaway.
scenes.change_from_previous: Return to the hero object from the opening, now with the full process visible around it.
scenes.motion_purpose: The final move resolves the route and stops; no further motion signals completion.
scenes.hold_reason: Leave the final sentence and joined route still for a deliberate ending hold.
